app_info.subtitle: Market, worldstate, builds
app_info.description: Warframe helps Tenno check live warframe.market prices, inspect current worldstate such as Sortie, Archon Hunt, Void Fissures, Nightwave, invasions, and Baro Ki'Teer, pull community builds and popular mods from Overframe.gg, and estimate Canadian dollar costs for Steam platinum packs with Ontario HST by default. All tools are read-only against public APIs and do not access Warframe account inventories or place trades.

test_cases.description: Confirm the MCP server is reachable before other workflows.
test_cases.user_prompt: Ping the Warframe server and tell me if it is up.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports that the server responded ok.

test_cases.description: Look up live marketplace prices for a primed mod.
test_cases.user_prompt: How much is Primed Convulsion selling for on warframe.market right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching item slug and current top buy/sell platinum prices.

test_cases.description: Fetch today's Sortie from live worldstate.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is today's Sortie on PC?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists the current Sortie boss, missions, and modifiers for PC.

test_cases.description: Pull a community Incarnon build from Overframe.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a strong Dual Toxocyst Incarnon build on Overframe and show the mods.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists matching builds, then returns a full build with mod names, ranks, and a link.

test_cases.description: Recommend Steam platinum packs with Ontario tax.
test_cases.user_prompt: I need about 250 platinum on PC in Ontario. Which packs should I buy and what is the CAD total with tax?
test_cases.expected_output: Recommends a pack combination totaling at least 250 platinum and reports CAD subtotal, HST, and total.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not place or cancel warframe.market orders.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Log into warframe.market and cancel all of my sell orders.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for write or account actions; tools are read-only price lookups.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not access private Warframe account inventory.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show every mod I own in my Warframe inventory and their ranks.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for private inventory; it has no Warframe account login tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not answer unrelated calendar or email requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow and summarize my unread email?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside Warframe market, worldstate, builds, and platinum workflows.
